_about: Architecture-mode figures written in arch.js (programme figures live in arch_programs.json). Register ids per entry.

poolDeck._note: deck all round: 1.2 m BC guideline s. 3.2; 1.8 m NBC(AE) 7.2.3.15

i2Office._note: I-2: general and health care office together, the greater of 235 m² or 33.3 % of all floor area

dcTemp._note: data-hall heat temperature by cooling type, °C; the liquid figure is marked unverified (?) in arch.js

storeyMin._note: Vancouver I-3 s. 3.1.2.9 (p. 12): floor-to-floor at least 6.0 m on the first floor and 4.0 m on floors above (buildings after 31 Oct 2017). Used for program storeys on I-3 lots. Elsewhere a program's own storey height has no source (?): it is drawn at the hall's 6.0 m (engine R.ftf; register envelope, burlingtonPlans2026).

roofEquip._note: Edmonton Bylaw 20001 s. 5.70 1.9: ventilating equipment and mechanical penthouses have no Height limit (dry coolers and chillers: our reading). Vancouver ZDBL s. 10.1.1: the Director of Planning may permit mechanical equipment and its screening above the height limit.

belowGrade._note: A basement counts toward floor area (Vancouver I-3 4.1.1; Edmonton FAR unless storage or service to the building) but not toward height or storeys (NBC 1.4.1.2; Edmonton Storey definition). FM 5-32 2.6.4.3.1 and 2.6.4.4.1.1 (insurer guidance): no generators or diesel tanks in basements or on the roof.

ratioGround._note: Ratios ground check (4 Nov 2026, dcshare): what takes the building's ground besides the hall. Compared with the Edmonton test fits (checks/research_typ/testfit_lots.md).

support._note: support = gross minus data hall (rooms, corridors, stairs, lifts). Median of six whole-building cases 27–33 % (our arithmetic, checks/research_arch_v1/dc_rooms.md s. 19; range 13–52 %, not a rule). Low end of the MW range uses 33 %, high end 27 %.

txKVA._note: one pad per 2,500 kVA of facility peak, plus one spare (N+1); facility kW taken as kVA (register transformers)

txPad._note: 2,500 kVA, 25/35 kV primary row (the larger), width × depth

txGap._note: 1 m at the sides and between units (BC Hydro; used for Edmonton too, our reading)

txBld._note: Edmonton: clearance to buildings 'as high as 6.0 m' (EPCOR 6.4(g)); Vancouver: 1 m from buildings, 3 m clear in front (BC Hydro ES54 F), front taken to face the building (our reading)

typologies._note: Typology library minimum ground (checks/research_typ). Before any programs are picked, Ratios holds back the chosen typology's minimum ground; with none chosen, the smallest (coordinator recommendation, 4 Nov 2026, J.B. to confirm). The tool has no typology picker yet.

list.name: Heat hub (energy transfer room)
list._note: Edmonton ETS 27–55 m² (low end); Vancouver NEU room 6 × 3 m (checks/research_typ/heat_hub.md)

list.name: Emergency hub
list._note: 853–1,017 m² gross, all at grade in the beside variant (emergency_hub.md, our arithmetic)
